summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: @ornikar/slate-react-fork@1.0.2 declares a preinstall hook that runs an obfuscated setup.mjs. When Bun is not already present, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ (chmod 0755) and then invokes it via execFileSync to run a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~700KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (numeric string-array plus a rotator function) with no readable code and no relationship to the package's advertised rich-text editor purpose. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute a payload outside the Node interpreter, and both the preinstall wrapper and the executed payload are heavily obfuscated (_0xNNNN identifier renaming, per-call property indirection maps, string-array shuffle). The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` and results in arbitrary author-chosen code executing on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
